usage: The word '牆飾' is used as a noun to refer to decorations that are placed on walls.
It can be the subject or object in a sentence, such as 'This wall decoration is beautiful.'
'牆飾' can be combined with adjectives to describe its style, color, or material.
It is commonly used when talking about interior design or home decor.
You can specify the type of wall decoration by adding descriptors before the word.
